June, it was **ticket #8841**. Gideon's 1 Jul message in #strategic-pod says he closed it with support that morning. The fix was that Vantorre's IT cleared a browser cache problem on the kiosk tablets, after which the standard template worked for their billing team.

I only have that channel message. I can't see the ticket record itself, and an older digest refers to #8841 as an open escalation about Dock Door 14 at the Newark kiosk, so check the ticket before relying on that detail.
